### **Gleba Circuit-Free Starter Base (50 SPM)**

This blueprint was built for my **Gleba “no circuits” challenge** (zero green/red wires). It is a real, stable starter base you can run in a normal save, but the main goal was the challenge itself. Full details, design notes, and rationale are in the Reddit post—recommended reading: [Circuit-Free Gleba Challenge](https://www.reddit.com/r/factorio/comments/1q20ut3/circuitfree_gleba_challenge_i_built_a_full_base/)


**What it does**

* ~**50 SPM**
* Produces key Gleba items: **Biochambers**, **Stack Inserters**, **Module 3**, **Artificial Soil**
* **Rockets to space**
* Designed to run indefinitely after a brief kickstart (within the stated input assumptions)

**How to start**

1. Connect the inputs: ~**10 fruits/sec** of each type is more than enough.
2. Add fuel until the factory has power.
3. Follow the display panel instructions: add **initial nutrients** to bootstrap, then add **a single pentapod egg**.
title: Gleba without Circuits
